subject: Renewal + proposed hosted commit increase — proposed schedule and pricing

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@aceros.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop, ben_carter
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + proposed hosted commit increase — initial proposal

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per Aceros' roadmap, I put together a short proposal to renew your Hosted API agreement and increase the monthly commit to support the forecasted Q2 query volume spike. Key points:

- Current: 3M tokens/month hosted commit (monthly billing cadence)
- Proposal: increase to 6M tokens/month with a 12-month term (starts 2027-03-01)
- Pricing: blended unit price at the 6M tier (see attached pricing-proposal-v3.xlsx) — includes a 12% volume discount vs current list
- Rate limits: burst window expanded to 3x baseline for two scheduled maintenance windows per month; baseline RPS adjusts with tier
- SLA appendix: minor language additions for throughput during peak sync windows (attached)

Next steps I propose:
1) I share the formal proposal and SLA appendix (attached).
2) You confirm procurement timeline and any PO requirements.
3) We incorporate any necessary legal redlines and finalize DocuSign — target signature by 2027-02-05 to lock pricing.

If you want, I can run a quick simulation of expected p95 latency at 6M/month on your traffic profile and share results in 48 hours.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Exec — Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_pricing-proposal-v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_SLA_Appendix.pdf (PDF)

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear proposal. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- Procurement asks for the exact start date and an invoice schedule that aligns to our fiscal month (starts 1st of month). Can you confirm start = 2027-03-01 and monthly invoices on the 1st?
- We need a short note on how overage is handled if we exceed the 6M commit in a given month. Is it automatic billing at list rates or do you throttle?
- Ellen (cc) will drive legal on redlines; she flagged that we need explicit data retention language and SOC 2 evidence before signature.

Also — pricing looks reasonable but need internal approval around the 12% discount floor. Can you hold pricing until next Friday while I run approvals?

Jordan
Head of AI Products — Aceros Retail
